changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE organizations ( id uuid NOT NULL, tenant_id uuid, branch_id uuid, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp(6) with time zone, created_by varchar(255), updated_by varchar(255), deleted boolean NOT NULL,
-- Company identity (frontend CompanyIdentity) registered_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, trading_name varchar(255), rc_number varchar(255) NOT NULL, company_type varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (company_type IN ('LIMITED_LIABILITY', 'PLC', 'BUSINESS_NAME_ENTERPRISE', 'INCORPORATED_TRUSTEES')), date_of_incorporation date NOT NULL,
-- Registered address registered_street varchar(255) NOT NULL, registered_city varchar(255) NOT NULL, registered_state varchar(100) NOT NULL,
-- Operating address operating_street varchar(255) NOT NULL, operating_city varchar(255) NOT NULL, operating_state varchar(100) NOT NULL,
-- Presence (frontend CompanyPresence) company_email varchar(255) NOT NULL, company_phone varchar(255) NOT NULL, website varchar(255), social_instagram varchar(255), social_twitter varchar(255), social_facebook varchar(255), social_linkedin varchar(255),
-- Plan and entitlements plan varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (plan IN ('STARTER', 'GROWTH', 'ENTERPRISE')), marketplace_publishing boolean NOT NULL, mlm_module boolean NOT NULL, fx_rails boolean NOT NULL,
-- The two independent status axes — see column comments below status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'OFFBOARDED')), verification_state varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (verification_state IN ('CREATED', 'DOCUMENTS_SUBMITTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'VERIFIED', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED')),
PRIMARY KEY (id) );
COMMENT ON COLUMN organizations.status IS 'Can this tenant''s staff use the portal at all? Independent of verification_state — e.g. a suspended-for-non-payment tenant can still be VERIFIED.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN organizations.verification_state IS 'Can this tenant publish to the marketplace or collect payments? Independent of status — e.g. an ACTIVE tenant can still be UNDER_REVIEW while it explores the portal and sets up estates.';

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE organization_states ( id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, state varchar(100) NOT NULL, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id) );
